notes.title: A Mysterious Invitation: Try the New Demo of OUR NEW GAME – YOUR HOUSE!
notes.content:
[h3]Hey, Delete After Reading community![/h3]

If you loved unraveling secrets, playing with text, and immersing yourself in a thrilling interactive mystery, we have something special for you. 🏡🔑

🔎 [b]The new demo is live[/b]! Are you ready to play?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3309260/YOUR_HOUSE_Demo/

[h3]👉 YOUR HOUSE - Home Is Where the Secrets Are 👈[/h3]

A game you can read, a book you can play—YOUR HOUSE is a text-driven puzzle adventure where the walls of a mysterious mansion hold the truth about a rebellious teenager and the mother who abandoned her years ago.

[b]Why should you play? [/b]
✔ A Unique Narrative Format – Like Delete After Reading, this is more than a game; it’s an experience where text, puzzles, and story blend seamlessly.
✔ A House of Secrets – Navigate a mansion designed as a puzzle, unlocking hidden rooms and buried truths.
✔ A Noir Mystery with Depth – A rebellious teen, a master architect-thief, and a story of freedom, sacrifice, and identity.
✔ Puzzles that Tell a Story – Every challenge is part of the narrative. No random tasks—only meaningful mysteries.

[previewyoutube=e2qyE95jmUs;full][/previewyoutube]

If you enjoyed Delete After Reading, you’ll love how YOUR HOUSE pushes the boundaries of storytelling and interactivity. Let us know what you think—just don’t delete it too soon!
